bio_am: Ղարաբաղցի։ 1897-ի Խանասորի արշաւանքի հրամանատարը, մահացած է Երեւան՝ 1943-ին։
bio_en: Sargis (Sergey) Mehrabian, known as Khanasor Vardan, was a native of Karabakh who served in the Russian army before joining the ARF early on. After working in Persian Atrpatakan, through which arms and fighting bands flowed to the homeland, he went to Van in 1895, returning to Atrpatakan under Turkish pursuit. On 27 July 1897 he commanded the Khanasor expedition, the first organised armed demonstration of the Armenian revolution, with Nikol Duman as one of his officers. In 1905-06 he led the fighting against the Tatars in Karabakh from Shushi, at Varanda, Khachen, Karkar and Askeran, and in the First World War he commanded the Ararat volunteer regiment. He spent his last 25 years in isolation in Soviet Yerevan, where he died in 1943.
